records.note: 'Replace classic antidepressants over time' names no metric, no threshold, no data series and no period. 'Replace' is a comparative with no benchmark in the words: any quantity_threshold event (psilocybin volume versus antidepressant volume, a share, a count) would invent the metric and the threshold. 'Over time after approval by medical authorities' is not a deadline. The sentence is an adoption-scale slogan, so VAGUE. Fails test (f).

'A durable version of TMS for ADHD' names no trial, no durability benchmark (duration or response measure), no protocol and no deciding body. The claim is about treatment effect, not a regulatory decision: mapping it to E-0063 (FDA authorizes a TMS device for ADHD) would invent the decider and the outcome type, and a trial_result event would invent the trial and the threshold. 'Dubious' is also not a lexicon phrase (nearest 'doubtful', bin D), but the item fails test (f) first. VAGUE.

readings: 'the drug' = the atai psychedelic therapeutic whose Phase 3 trial produced the data in the condition; the forecaster names no compound, so any atai program counts, as in E-0029.
The words name the FDA; E-0029 also counts another major regulator. The reading is logged: an FDA approval is the outcome the forecaster asserts.

condition.asset: Any psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences: a Phase 3 trial meets its primary endpoint
condition.entity: atai Life Sciences (sponsor, or its subsidiary, successor or partner)
condition.title: An atai psychedelic program reports a Phase 3 trial that meets its primary endpoint
condition.proposition: A Phase 3 trial of a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences reports its prespecified primary endpoint met.
condition.criterion: TRUE on the date of the sponsor's topline press release, or the publication, that first reports a Phase 3 trial of a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences (or its subsidiary, successor or partner) with its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance, as reported by the sponsor. A psychedelic therapeutic is a compound its sponsor or the regulator describes as a psychedelic or an entactogen; esketamine and ketamine are excluded. A Phase 2 result, an open-label result, an interim analysis or a secondary endpoint is not a Phase 3 primary result. Resolution source: the sponsor's topline press release, with ClinicalTrials.gov results as a secondary source. FALSE at the deadline when no such Phase 3 result has been reported.

resolution_source.name: Sponsor topline press release; ClinicalTrials.gov results as a secondary source

readings: 'if we produce the clinical data in phase three' = an atai Phase 3 trial meets its prespecified primary endpoint; the trial result is decided by the data, not by an atai decision, so the condition is observable and outside the forecaster's control.
No compound is named; on the statement date no atai program had a Phase 3 trial, so any atai psychedelic program counts.

records.phrase: it's an automatism that the FDA ... will say ... we're going to approve the drug
records.stage_note: On 2024-05-08 no atai psychedelic program was in Phase 3 (lead programs BPL-003, VLS-01 and EMP-01 were in Phase 2). The item is conditional on a positive Phase 3 result, and no class in base-rates.json gives P(approval | positive Phase 3, no NDA yet); the ledger abstains rather than substitute a class.
records.note: Conditional 'if A then B': A = atai produces positive Phase 3 data (a trial outcome, not a company decision, so not CONTROL); B = the FDA approves the drug, which a third party decides. The claim is the forecaster's own expectation about the FDA, not information. Event B maps to E-0029 (a major regulator approves an atai psychedelic therapeutic, any indication). Bin A on 'will' and 'it's an automatism'; 'I'm very confident' qualifies the condition, not the outcome. No date in the words: undated panel. Affiliated: atai chairman.
